notes.title: Book of Korvald OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132380/Book_of_Korvald/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/23168fc4cd830526adb12d799beadc2bc4561bf3.png[/img]

[b]Book of Korvald is OUT NOW on Steam! [/b]Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with a parasitic eldritch entity. Join forces with beautiful warrior nuns, sexy mythical figures and lustful interdimensional creatures to prevent our world from being devoured. Can you contain your sexual urges and fight to survive? 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d3c80a887ca8238abdab5c93b2d5b5898a832691.png[/img]

Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with an eldritch entity named "Qhroth'un".

History does not tell us that Norse clans had scribes of their own. Their folklore is said to have been preserved through oral traditions exclusively, but this is not the truth. Many written sagas were damaging to the reputation of royal families and expository to the church. So these writings, along with their authors, were aggressively purged from existence. Korvald was one such scribe.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/15b48123089c8e96badd36a288b47601ddd51a32.png[/img]
Korvald's is not a tale of heroism and justice, but of deceit and suffering provoked by powerful religious empires and unseen cosmic forces. His story begins as so many are ended. Family slain and taken from his now destroyed village, Korvald is branded as a heretic and seemingly condemned to death. The true purpose of his capture and torment are part of a much bigger and far more sinister agenda. In his darkest hour, Korvald is approached by Qhroth'un and an agreement is made that will change everything...
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/34357d04c1a657d9fa8a369dea66d188a6eb5296.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/b86b29fe922ffe18811ada8f7d7ccd48f640e7ac.png[/img]
- Over 50 different female characters complete with sexual encounters. All raw, hot and fully animated.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/38fd4b2ffa2893f6a86a66601d87132087cb5223.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/08699a9b705e37b3c59df293d8faf0e5f919c4cd.png[/img]

[b]Maps / Environments / Areas:[/b]
- Each chapter takes place across an entire country, spanning over 30 areas. Starting in Denmark near the city of Ribe, drawing inspiration from the conversion to Christianity that took place around the 9th century in Scandinavia.

[b]Weapons:[/b]
- 200+ different weapons to find or buy from various shops. Axes, Swords, Maces, Whips, Spears, Flails, Daggers, Shields, and Books (yes books).

[b]Artifacts:[/b]
- 30+ different artifacts and special off-hand weapons to equip. You could raise the dead Templar knights as zombie minions, inflict plagues on nearby enemies, and even cause certain NPCs (and even some enemies) to strip naked (because... why not?).

[b]Runes:[/b]
- Korvald will discover the true meaning and origin of runes and runestones. Utilizing his unique insight into this powerful language, he will gain the ability to harness many destructive and helpful forces. Unleash flaming cyclones, lightning storms, arctic blizzards, healing waters and even summon eldritch creatures to aid you in combat.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/64388e27ba7f7491195e40dbedc0a6e1437ced41.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132380/Book_of_Korvald/

BoneTown joins Shady Corner Games! The classic OG porn game has become part of our family. With new features and polished mechanics and planned DLC its a Second Coming that we are happy to give to you all~

[b]Want to party with hot chicks and get laid in a free-roaming video game?[/b] 

BoneTown is the first game to combine free roaming, action adventure gameplay with sex, drugs, and debauchery in one hilariously hardcore experience!

Merging games like Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption with outrageous drug-induced and sexual powers never before allowed in a video game, BoneTown creates a world where crack makes you run quicker, weed lets you jump higher, and of course, you get to bone your way to the top as you seduce thousands of unique girls.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/c03e8a3bdac45c0b7e17efbd7d6c7cb2899f4bee.jpg[/img]

Want to nail a nun, do a dominatrix, jizz on a juicer, or eat out an eighteen-year-old? You've come to the right place.

In BoneTown, sex on the sidewalk is as common as sex in the bedroom, and the only thing to be ashamed of is not having enough stamina to finish what you start. Every girl you see is fair game—if you have big enough Balls to convince her to bone you. The hottest girls on the island will always choose the guys with the biggest Balls, and a guy with small Balls will need to start at the bottom unless he’s willing to pay for it.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/52ae604daccc5b2c29af5d7546fee3b191d873f7.jpg[/img]

Not only is sex fun, but in BoneTown it’s essential. From the blowjobs that increase your Health, to the sex that gives you bigger Balls, or the anal which does both, sex is a major part of succeeding in BoneTown.

Then, we doubled the number of competitions and other gameplay missions within each level. notes.title: Update notes for Nov 2023
notes.content:
I was doing the new level last week, but during the tests going through the path from level 1 I realized that the game had some broken things that used to work, I don't know if at some point I edited something and broke the code.

The important thing is that I had to get it all the way to the new level (which is level 4 in world 2), and after a week the version is ready, level 4 is still under construction because I had to go back and fix the whole path, from the tests I've done now it seems that everything is working well but, as usual, only testing with other players can say for sure.

[u]Here a list of the main bugs I've fixed:[/u]

[list]
[*] First mini boss was stuck at some animations
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34969713/7a7f4dfce0aecab7a8dac9da1fe52d20046c867c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Scuba Cow mini gun quest sometimes didn't work
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34969713/1a6a9972841d5e3f208eadfb5092dd6ef6dcd81c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Anemone Girl seed quest sometimes didn't work
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34969713/acb1764d095172fffa12c0c559b11e2c2f8f3a12.png[/img]

[list]
[*] First Boss battle the rematch was also repeating some texts that aren't supposed to
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34969713/0ee334de0cef852ba1ac24b6c28cfdc00650d5ad.png[/img]

[b]Right now I'm back to the level 4 work so I can finally finish it and release to the test.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34969713/0caf8647dcafd2c151fffda77137384353f247a2.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update (v1.1.9)
notes.content:
Here are the note about what was done for this update:
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs for level 1 and 2.
[*] Fixed bugs for SBA minigame.
[*] Added control support (gamepad).
[*] Added battle with the police bots on level 2.
[*] Added player control to stop manually each roulette every time you press the action button (Z).
[/list]
Features being worked on for the next update:
[list]
[*] Add easy way to handle Save
[*] Add ship level with the mermaids to interact (Garry' Ship)
[*] Add save point (checkpoint) in the levels.
[*] Add crocodile reward.
[*] Add challenge level looking for wild marine pepper.
[*] Add second boss, the shark girl.
[/list]
[i]Note, for now I don't intend to keep the old saves, you will have to restart the game to see all the changes, but I will provide some saves that I have made so you can leave from there if you don't want to go back from the beginning.[/i]
[url=https://guilherme-vargas.itch.io/rescue-of-mermaids-files]Download the save files here![/url]

notes.content:
I delayed a bit last week's update to resolve the bugs and also add more thing to level 2 of the game in order to provide more game progress.

Thank you all for understanding :3
